verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product that works alongside coding agents. Through its MCP server, CLI and "Fix with cubic" pushes, a unified place to manage agent work is a plausible ask, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows a workspace for launching, tracking or managing multiple agent-driven coding sessions. The analytics dashboard reports AI coding usage on merged PRs, and the MCP server feeds review findings to an external agent; both are adjacent features, not session management.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace
